system.description:
The power of your Beast is such that entire gatherings of mortals can be driven off in terror or cowed into submission.

Although this ability matches the effects of Cowing the Beast, it operates on groups of mortals: you must be able to see the people to affect them, but you need not lock eyes. Spend one Social Trait per target you wish to affect and win a Social Challenge against each. Each affected target must immediately flee, is prohibited from spending Willpower Traits, and receives the Negative Trait Submissive x2 for the rest of the night. This ability does not work on vampires; Animal Ken serves for retests.
